# scaleway_dataorchestrator_workflow_resume (Action)

Resumes a paused Scaleway Data Orchestrator workflow run.


<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workflow_run_id` (String) ID of the workflow run to resume.

### Optional

- `region` (String) Region of the workflow run. If unset, derived from a regional ID or the provider default region.
